heightM.note: the arena's roof edge above the street, proportioned by eye

glazedBaseM.note: the glazed concourse level under the metal band

length.note: the arena body's length and width (a rounded oblong)

headingDeg.note: compass heading of the arena's long axis, along the avenue to its south (by eye)

canopyHeadingDeg.note: compass heading from the arena's middle to the entrance canopy over the corner plaza

canopyDistanceM.note: from the arena's middle to the canopy's middle

canopyM.note: the canopy's height above the plaza

readabilityScale.note: A generic arena (LEGAL-1: no logos, sponsor or team names, signage or text; the canopy's ring screen is a plain colour).

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.6 and plan x1.15 like the ballparks, so the arena reads at the 3,000-4,500 m game camera.
